scripts.Setup: install composer dependencies: docker exec -it 4s-deploy-service-app sh -c "cd ci4 && composer install && cd ../zmq-server && composer install && cd ../zmq-client && composer install"
scripts.Setup: migrate: docker exec -it 4s-deploy-service-app sh -c "cd ci4 && php spark migrate"
scripts.Tools: rerun last migration: docker exec -it 4s-deploy-service-app sh -c "cd ci4 && php spark app:migrate"
scripts.Tools: sync models & api: docker exec -it 4s-deploy-service-app sh -c "cd ci4 && php spark dev:sync_models_and_api"
scripts.Test: unit (no database): docker exec 4s-deploy-service-app sh -c "cd ci4 && vendor/bin/phpunit --colors=always --testsuite unit"
scripts.Test: no cluster (database only): docker exec 4s-deploy-service-app sh -c "cd ci4 && vendor/bin/phpunit --colors=always --testsuite unit,database"
scripts.Test: coverage (per file): scripts/test.sh --coverage-clover build/clover.xml >/dev/null && docker exec 4s-deploy-service-app sh -c "cd ci4 && php ../scripts/coverage-table.php build/clover.xml $npm_config_file"
scripts.Test: setup database (run once): docker exec -e DB_HOST=db -e DB_NAME=deploy_tests -e DB_USER=root -e DB_PASS=root -e DB_PORT=3306 4s-deploy-service-app sh -c "cd ci4 && php spark migrate"
